preconditions.description: The number of horses in the horse land is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of enemy pairs is between 1 and the maximum possible number of enemy pairs (n*(n-1)/2), but each horse has at most 3 enemies, so m is at most 300.
Each horse index ai and bi is between 1 and n, inclusive.
No horse is an enemy of itself.

postconditions.expression: output is a string of length n
postconditions.description: The output is a string of length n, where each character is either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 if no valid party split exists
postconditions.description: If it is not possible to split the horses into two parties such that each horse has at most one enemy in its party, the output is -1.
